# TableDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Describes a table layout. Provides scoped methods for defining columns, headers, footers, and cells. Maps to a `Table` element internally.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new TableDescriptor()
```

## Methods

- [`Border`](#border): Sets a uniform border for all cells.
- [`Cell`](#cell): Returns a container for the next cell.
- [`CellPadding`](#cellpadding): Sets the default cell padding in points.
- [`Columns`](#columns): Defines the column weights for the table.
- [`Footer`](#footer): Adds a footer row to the table.
- [`Header`](#header): Adds a header row to the table.
- [`HeaderBackground`](#headerbackground): Sets the header background color.
- [`HeaderTextColor`](#headertextcolor): Sets the header text color.
- [`RepeatHeaders`](#repeatheaders): Sets whether headers repeat on each page.
- [`Row`](#row): Adds a full row to the table.

Sets a uniform border for all cells.

IContentContainer Cell()

### `Columns`

```csharp
void Columns(params float[] weights)
```

Defines the column weights for the table.

- `weights`: Column weights (proportional). E.g., (2f, 1f, 1f) creates a 2:1:1 ratio.
